data.one_liner: Flutter package for animating TextField hint and label text with transitions.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimatedTextField widget that animates hint or label text inside text input fields using styles like slide, fade, and typer animations. Supports static prefix or suffix hints alongside the animated segments.
use_when: You want to display changing or suggestive hint text inside search bars or text fields.
You need standard text field features combined with animated hints (slide, fade, typer).
avoid_when: You need complete control over custom form state management rather than a simple themed text field widget.
strengths: Supports multiple animation types like slide, fade, and typer.
Allows static prefix and suffix text alongside animated hint parts.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Linux, and Windows.
weaknesses: Limited to specific pre-built hint animations.
Depends on external animation packages like animated_text_kit.
